source: CDN observability schema and all current dashboards, 2026-11-19

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 总节点数
queries: SELECT count() AS value FROM scdn.node_inventory FINAL WHERE enabled=1 AND node IN (${node:singlequote})

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 在线健康节点
queries: SELECT countIf(seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND sync_ok=1) AS value FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(sync_ok,time) sync_ok,argMax(sites,time) sites,argMax(ban_records,time) records,argMax(cpu_pct,time) cpu,argMax(mem_pct,time) memory,argMax(cache_disk_pct,time) disk FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 总站点数
queries: SELECT uniqExact(site) AS value FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(sites) site FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(sync_ok,time) sync_ok,argMax(sites,time) sites,argMax(ban_records,time) records,argMax(cpu_pct,time) cpu,argMax(mem_pct,time) memory,argMax(cache_disk_pct,time) disk FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node)) WHERE site IN (${site:singlequote})

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 总请求数
queries: SELECT count() AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 总拦截数
queries: SELECT countIf(blocked=1) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 总拉黑 IP 数
queries: SELECT uniqExactIf(ip,action='APPLIED' AND applied=1) AS value FROM scdn.bans WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (scope='*' OR scope IN (${site:singlequote}))

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 缓存命中率
queries: SELECT 100.0*countIf(cache IN ('HIT','STALE','UPDATING','REVALIDATED'))/nullIf(countIf(cache IN ('HIT','MISS','EXPIRED','STALE','UPDATING','REVALIDATED')),0) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 总流量 · 下行正文
queries: SELECT sum(bytes) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 缓存流量
queries: SELECT sumIf(bytes,cache IN ('HIT','STALE','UPDATING','REVALIDATED')) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 独立请求 IP
queries: SELECT uniqExact(ip) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 5xx 错误率
queries: SELECT 100.0*countIf(status>=500 AND status<600)/nullIf(count(),0) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: P95 请求耗时
queries: SELECT quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration_ms) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 缓存流量占比
queries: SELECT 100.0*sumIf(bytes,cache IN ('HIT','STALE','UPDATING','REVALIDATED'))/nullIf(sum(bytes),0) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 回源代理请求
queries: SELECT countIf(origin_seen=1) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: HTTP/3 请求占比
queries: SELECT 100.0*countIf(protocol='HTTP/3.0')/nullIf(count(),0) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 源站/上游 403
queries: SELECT countIf(status=403 AND origin_seen=1) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 独立请求 URI
queries: SELECT uniqExact(uri) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: P99 请求耗时
queries: SELECT quantileTDigest(0.99)(duration_ms) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 请求速率 · QPS
queries: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,count()/greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)) AS QPS FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 下行正文带宽 · 总量 / 缓存
queries: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,8*sum(bytes)/greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)) AS `总带宽`,8*sumIf(bytes,cache IN ('HIT','STALE','UPDATING','REVALIDATED'))/greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)) AS `缓存带宽` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 请求状态码分类趋势
queries: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,concat(toString(intDiv(status,100)),'xx') AS metric,count() AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY time,metric ORDER BY time

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 请求耗时 · P50 / P95 / P99
queries: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,quantileTDigest(0.50)(duration_ms) AS P50,quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration_ms) AS P95,quantileTDigest(0.99)(duration_ms) AS P99 FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 缓存状态趋势
queries: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,cache AS metric,count() AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY time,metric ORDER BY time

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 边缘拦截趋势
queries: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,block_reason AS metric,count() AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND blocked=1 GROUP BY time,metric ORDER BY time

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 总请求状态码
queries: SELECT toString(status) AS `状态码`,count() AS `请求数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节`,round(avg(duration_ms),2) AS `平均耗时_ms` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY status ORDER BY `请求数` DESC

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: HTTP 协议分布
queries: SELECT protocol AS `协议`,count() AS `请求数` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY protocol ORDER BY `请求数` DESC

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: L1 / L2 / 回源 / 绕过分布
queries: SELECT cache_layer AS `缓存层`,cache AS `缓存状态`,count() AS `请求数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY cache_layer,cache ORDER BY `请求数` DESC

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: HTTP 方法分布
queries: SELECT method AS `方法`,count() AS `请求数` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY method ORDER BY `请求数` DESC

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: Top 10 请求 IP
queries: SELECT ip AS `请求IP`,count() AS `请求数`,countIf(blocked=1) AS `拦截数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节`,any(country) AS `国家`,any(operator) AS `运营商_ASN机构` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY ip ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 10

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: Top 10 请求站点
queries: SELECT site AS `站点ID`,any(host) AS `域名`,count() AS `请求数`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND site!='__unregistered__' GROUP BY site ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 10

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: Top 10 请求 URI
queries: SELECT uri AS `URI路径`,count() AS `请求数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节`,round(quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration_ms),2) AS P95_ms FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY uri ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 10

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: Top 10 拦截 IP
queries: SELECT ip AS `请求IP`,count() AS `拦截数`,any(country) AS `国家`,any(operator) AS `运营商_ASN机构` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND blocked=1 GROUP BY ip ORDER BY `拦截数` DESC LIMIT 10

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 请求 IP 地理位置数量统计
queries: SELECT country AS `国家_地区代码`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP数`,count() AS `请求数`,countIf(blocked=1) AS `拦截数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY country ORDER BY `请求数` DESC

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 请求 IP ASN 统计
queries: SELECT concat('AS',toString(asn)) AS ASN,any(asn_org) AS `ASN机构`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP数`,count() AS `请求数`,countIf(blocked=1) AS `拦截数` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY asn ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 30

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 请求 IP 运营商统计
queries: SELECT operator AS `运营商_ASN机构`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP数`,count() AS `请求数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY operator ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 30

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: IPv4 / IPv6 请求分布
queries: SELECT concat('IPv',toString(ip_family)) AS `地址族`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP数`,count() AS `请求数` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY ip_family

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 节点 CPU 使用率
queries: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,node AS metric,avg(cpu_pct) AS value FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY time,node ORDER BY time

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 节点内存使用率
queries: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,node AS metric,avg(mem_pct) AS value FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY time,node ORDER BY time

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 节点缓存磁盘使用率
queries: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,node AS metric,avg(cache_disk_pct) AS value FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY time,node ORDER BY time

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 节点网卡发送带宽
queries: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,node AS metric,avg(tx_bps) AS value FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY time,node ORDER BY time

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 节点当前状态
queries: SELECT node AS `节点`,seen AS `最后采集`,if(seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND sync_ok=1,'在线','离线或异常') AS `同步健康`,sites AS `启用站点`,round(cpu,2) AS `CPU_百分比`,round(memory,2) AS `内存_百分比`,round(disk,2) AS `缓存盘_百分比` FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(sync_ok,time) sync_ok,argMax(sites,time) sites,argMax(ban_records,time) records,argMax(cpu_pct,time) cpu,argMax(mem_pct,time) memory,argMax(cache_disk_pct,time) disk FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node) ORDER BY node

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览
panels.title: 采集进度与历史覆盖
queries: SELECT node AS `节点`,max(time) AS `最后采集`,argMax(success,time) AS `采集成功`,argMax(completed_files,time) AS `已补齐归档数`,argMax(source_files,time) AS `发现日志文件数`,sum(inserted) AS `本时间段写入行数_含重试`,sum(invalid) AS `无效行数`,argMax(error,time) AS `最近错误` FROM scdn.collection_health WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node ORDER BY node

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN · 访问与缓存明细

queries: SELECT sum(bytes) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

panels.title: P95 耗时
queries: SELECT quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration_ms) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

panels.dashboard: PH_OpenResty CDN · 访问与缓存明细
panels.title: 5xx 请求
queries: SELECT countIf(status>=500) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

panels.title: L7 / L3 拉黑决策趋势
queries:
WITH greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)) AS step,
intDiv(intDiv(${__from},1000),step)*step AS first_bucket,
intDiv(intDiv(${__to},1000),step)*step AS last_bucket
SELECT toDateTime(bucket,'UTC') AS time,concat('L',toString(layer)) AS metric,
if((SELECT countIf(seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND ready=1) FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(ban_ready,time) ready,argMax(tuple(kernel_drop_counter),time).1 counter,argMax(ban_records,time) records FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node))=(SELECT count() FROM scdn.node_inventory FINAL WHERE enabled=1 AND node IN (${node:singlequote})),toNullable(ifNull(decisions,0)),NULL) AS value
FROM (SELECT toInt64(first_bucket+number*step) AS bucket,arrayJoin([toUInt8(7),toUInt8(3)]) AS layer
      FROM numbers(toUInt64(intDiv(last_bucket-first_bucket,step)+1))) AS timeline
LEFT JOIN (SELECT toInt64(toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(step)))) AS bucket,
                  layer,uniqExact(ban_id) AS decisions FROM scdn.bans
           WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (scope='*' OR scope IN (${site:singlequote})) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND layer IN (7,3) AND action='APPLIED' AND applied=1
           GROUP BY bucket,layer) AS measured USING(bucket,layer)
ORDER BY time,metric
